notablePrerequisites: Halo Fountain does not have summoning sickness.You control at least one basic Plains.
description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, turning Halo Fountain into an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped creature you control, untaaping a basic Plains you control.
Activate a basic Plains you control by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Halo Fountain by tapping and untapping itself, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
